notes.title: 1.3 The Conquest Update
notes.notes:
Factions can now claim stations through Conquest play. Attempting to claim an already claimed station will initiate a siege: A timed, ranked 'turfwar' between the attacking and defending faction
 You can now get (custom) inputs directly in function blocks by using input(“”) in the expression. Works both as a boolean and a numerical value (0,1)
 Map will now show more information about sectors, the stations within them, and potential factions owning said stations
 You can now set the spawn rotation of a Hinge by tuning
 Removed the shop’s daily rotation, so all sets and items are now always available
 Station and radio TTS announcements will now talk slightly slower
 Edited report panel text, fixed a spelling mistake, and added a confirmation for the severe griefing option
 Super Secret Settings
 Distance Sensor now has multiple checkboxes in tuning for what type of vehicles or objects it will detect. Undetected objects mean the laser go through it, allowing you to now also place the sensor behind other blocks
 Drills will no longer trigger haptic feedback when the vehicle storage is full
 Colors of star systems are now more realistic, representing real life star types in different lifestages
 Various internal reworks for faction-related activities, and UI loading in general
 Fixed Starkeeper (room) station not having a minimap icon
 Fixed the minimap elements size (for real this time)
 Fixed various UI inconsistencies and other small issues

notes.title: 1.1 The Logic Update 3
notes.notes:
Custom on-screen inputs of buttons and switches, which can be selected from within the Control Block
 Improved multiplayer vehicle sync reliability in spawning and position updates. Position updates should now also look a lot smoother for people with weaker internet connections
 Improved Conquest max vehicle size check to be both more accurate and performant
 Limit on the amount of Docks that can be launched in Conquest to prevent lagnukers
 ‘Push To Toggle’ logic block
 Editor hotbar and market listings correctly show block amounts that previously didn’t fit in the textbox, capped to 1 million
 Removed the useless ‘delete vehicle’ button from vehicle elements in the station launch list
 Some UI changes
 Patched lasers being able to fire in between connected blocks

notes.title: 1.0 The Conquest Update 1
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Delta quadrant, the map of a new galaxy filled with star systems, sectors, stations, and other sites to explore
 Rift Drives and Rift Crystals for intrasystem and interstellar travel
 Renamed ‘Return to Station’ to ‘Self-destruct’
 Seamless session switching
 Multiplayer rework to improve multi-session support
 Numerical node input and optimization boost for Reaction Wheels
 Removed current station ambience sounds from smaller stations
 Added a link to the full list of ncalc functions for the Logic Block in the tuning panel
 General improvements on a variety of internal services
 Patched Pistons being able to push blocks on the extension segment through blocks on the base segment
 Decreased the likelihood of ‘NeverConnected’ disconnects in multiplayer
 Fixed Solar Panels sometimes still breaking even when timely retracted using automated logic
 Fixed Spacelings all spawning in the same location
 Fixed being able to get negative credits (nice one atata)
 Various other bug fixes

notes.title: 0.8 The Workshop Update
notes.notes:
Online vehicle workshop
 New preset (example) vehicles to guide new players
 Reworked saving and loading of vehicles internally and UI
 Gave all paid add-on related content a more distinctive purple color
 Applied the previously introduced new UI features to chat panel
 Vehicles with overlapping blocks unable to save will now tell you which block is overlapping
 Search field for loading vehicles in the editor
 Fixed wedges sometimes flipping after a block was destroyed on the same segment

notes.title: 0.7 The Logic Update 2
notes.notes:
New numerical logic layer: Ontop of the existing ‘boolean’ logic, which exists of inputs and connections being either on or off, the new numerical logic layer can now transfer states in number values between blocks. I.e. a Speed Sensor outputs a number which can be connected to the target angle of a Hinge
 Constant On Signal, Delay, Constant Number, Speed Sensor, Threshold Gate, Numerical Switchbox, Memory Register, Numerical Inverter, Abs, Clamp, Function Block, Gauge, Dial, and Digital Display blocks
 Target rotation angle numerical input for Hinges
 Editor grid can now round blocks positions to half units instead of full units, allowing more control over placement and using blocks that are slab- or quarter-sized
 Dragging blocks to place them now correctly detects which blocks it already placed in your ‘drag’ and which it should not overwrite
 Reworked saving and loading for block-specific values and node connections
 Editor camera will no longer move on accident when you start dragging across the screen close to a logic node, with the intention of just dragging the node
 Updated account data sync and added debugging tools for finding issues in production


It might be a bit unclear for some logic blocks, which node is which. This is being worked on, but in the meantime you can refer to the image below. More explanation of each block and its inputs and outputs can be found in the in-game descriptions.
